after-completing-the-forsaken-tower-ques.npc: Thank you for helping to repair the Doors of Dinh. Kourend is a safer place because of you.

steps.npc: I'm Councillor Unkar, one of the members of the Kourend Council. We are responsible for running the entire Kingdom of Great Kourend.

steps.player: What brings you to Lovakengj then?

steps.npc: It's important for the council to maintain a good relationship with the rulers of the five houses. Although it is the council that rules, we can only do so with their support.
I'm here to help Lady Lovakengj out and to make sure she has everything she needs to rule effectively.

options.text: What are the Doors of Dinh?

steps.player: What are the Doors of Dinh?

steps.npc: They are a great set of doors built by the legendary smith, Dinh, in the early days of Kourend. They were created to imprison a deadly beast known as the Wintertodt.
Unfortunately, the doors were recently damaged, putting Kourend at risk. The master smith Undor, managed to repair them though, something he couldn't have done without you.

after-completing-the-a-kingdom-divided-q.npc: A step down from what I'm used to.

after-completing-the-a-kingdom-divided-q.player: Well you'd better get used to it. This is where you'll spend the rest of your life, however long that ends up being.

after-completing-the-a-kingdom-divided-q.npc: Oh, I'm all too aware of that. Here, I will fade into obscurity as the world forgets my actions. I've accepted it. Besides, it's for the best that I not be remembered.
I only hope that the work I did for my home endures. Everything I did was to ensure that Lovakengj prospered.

after-completing-the-a-kingdom-divided-q.player: I'm sure they'll be just fine. If anything, I imagine they're better off without you.

after-completing-the-a-kingdom-divided-q.npc: Don't be so sure. I've no doubt the new king has good intent, but our intentions mean little compared to our actions.

after-completing-the-a-kingdom-divided-q.player: Something you're all too aware of, I'm sure.

after-completing-the-a-kingdom-divided-q.npc: Indeed. But I guess only time will tell. Farewell human.
